prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1402; do not mention it.)
text: I was driving north on the main road and approached the intersection on a green light. As I entered the crossing, a vehicle coming from my right failed to stop for its red signal and struck the driver's side of my car. The impact pushed my vehicle sideways and I felt my left knee hit the dashboard and door frame. The airbags did not deploy, but I was unable to put weight on my leg for several minutes. Other drivers stopped to check on me, and police responded to the scene and prepared a report. I was taken by ambulance to the nearest hospital, where I was examined and told I had a knee injury that needed further evaluation. I have since been in touch with my doctor about ongoing pain, swelling, and limited movement in the knee, and I am following the treatment plan I was given.
